description: Risk-qualified weighted pools that choose the next non-survival PvE mission and its candidates.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_PvEMissionLottery. GamePvE_PickMission stores the selected row's Id in its LotteryId output, and on later picks removes the row with that same Id so the same lottery is not repeated consecutively.

Id_GlobalThreshold.simple: Risk band selecting which lottery pools are eligible.
Id_GlobalThreshold.technical: FName, default None. The picker iterates all PvEMissionLottery rows backwards, resolves each Id_GlobalThreshold in GlobalThresholdDataTables (DTM+0x300) and removes rows whose threshold is missing or whose inclusive [Min, Max] does not contain RiskValue. Only surviving rows participate in the lottery.

Weights.simple: Relative weight of choosing this lottery pool.
Weights.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f. After threshold and repeat filtering, one Weights entry per surviving row is passed to GamePvE_PickWeightedIndex (StoryFRand() over the sum, subtract-and-pick, last index if overrun). The chosen row's Id becomes the next LotteryId. This is distinct from MissionWeights, which selects a mission inside the chosen row.

Id_PvEMission.simple: Candidate PvE mission ids inside the pool.
Id_PvEMission.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. The picker builds a parallel weight list, skipping None ids, then chooses an index from those weights. The reconstructed code returns Lottery->Id_PvEMission[Pick] directly rather than indexing a filtered id list, so a None or otherwise skipped earlier slot can shift the returned mission; exported rows pad with None.

MissionWeights.simple: Relative weight of each candidate mission.
MissionWeights.technical: TArray<float>, default empty. For each non-None candidate the same-index MissionWeights value is used; if that mission id was already played it is multiplied by 0.01. The resulting weights are passed to GamePvE_PickWeightedIndex; exported rows use 1000.0 for enabled slots and 0.0 for disabled ones.

notes: The exported asset has 223 rows with FGameDataTableRow_PvEMissionLottery; the manager loads PvEMissionLotteryDataTable into PvEMissionLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x910).
This table applies only to non-survival mode (GameMode != 2); survival mode instead constructs PVE_SURVIVAL_MISSION_%02d ids and verifies them against PvEMissionDataTable.
The direct indexing quirk after skipping None candidates is explicitly recorded in the reconstructed source; it is a behaviour of this consumer, not an assumption about the data's intent.
Picker 0x1306610 is reconstructed; consult status/functions.json for byte status. Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspected.

usages.detail: GamePvE_PickMission filters lottery rows by risk threshold and previous lottery id.
Selects a lottery row by Weights and updates the repeat-exclusion id.
Builds per-mission weights with MissionWeights and a 0.01 repeat penalty.
Returns the picked mission id from the row's id array.
